deals.title: Unlocked Apple iPhone 17 Pro 256GB Smartphone for $1,070 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: Best Buy's Holiday Deal takes $30 off the iPhone 17 Pro 256GB, bringing it to $1,069.99. The phone is unlocked and works with major carriers, and Best Buy lists 24-month financing at $45 per month. Six free gifts are included with purchase, and trade-in credit is available. My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). Buy Now at Best Buy Features 6.3" display 256GB of built-in storage 48MP rear camera system with 8x optical-quality zoom 18MP front camera Up to 33 hours of video playback Unlocked for use with major carriers, including AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile

deals.title: Apple Mac mini w/ M6 (2026) for $779 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This Mac mini with the new M6 chip is $120 off and the best price we've seen for it. Buy Now at Amazon Features Apple M6 chip with next-generation CPU and GPU 16GB of unified memory 5" x 5" x 1.97" compact desktop design Three Thunderbolt 4 ports, HDMI port, and 2.5Gb Ethernet port Two USB-C ports and a headphone jack on the front Supports up to three external displays

deals.title: DeWalt 20V MAX Jobsite Bluetooth Speaker for $99 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: At Lowe's, this DeWalt jobsite speaker is $50 off. It runs on either 12V or 20V MAX DeWalt batteries, so it can share packs with other DeWalt cordless tools. MyLowe's Rewards members get free shipping on this order (it's free to join). Pickup may also be available. Offer ends January 27. Buy Now at Lowe's Features carry handle with phone holder dual speakers 100ft Bluetooth connectivity range

deals.title: Acer Nitro KGB271U 27" WQHD 200Hz FreeSync HDR10 IPS LED Monitor for $150 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: Best Buy has the Acer Nitro KGB271U 27" gaming monitor at $50 off. The 1440p resolution and 200Hz refresh rate come at a price that matches the Samsung Odyssey G5 27" 1440p monitor at $150 on the same page. My Best Buy members get free shipping on all orders (it's free to join). Buy Now at Best Buy Features 27" screen with 2560 x 1440 WQHD resolution IPS panel with up to 200Hz refresh rate 0.5ms response time AMD FreeSync Premium to reduce screen tearing HDR10 support with 90% DCI-P3 color coverage DisplayPort & HDMI inputs

deals.title: Lenovo Yoga 7i 16" 2K Touchscreen 2-in-1 Laptop for $650 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: As one of Best Buy's Black Friday doorbusters, this Lenovo Yoga 7i laptop has dropped by another $100 overnight. It's the best deal we've seen for this build and $220 cheaper than Amazon's price. Shipping is free and the deal ends on November 15. Buy Now at Best Buy Features 360-degree 2-in-1 convertible design Interactive touchscreen with stylus support Intel Core Ultra processor with NPU 16-inch display with Dolby Vision Model: Yoga 7i

deals.title: Anker Prime 14-Port Docking Station w/ Anker 621 5,000mAh MagGo Power Bank for $170 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: Anker's Black Friday sale has the Anker Prime 14-in-1 Charging Docking Station at $170 for members, which is $100 off. (It's free to join.) Plus, you'll get the Anker 621 5,000mAh MagGo Power Bank for free. That's $53 under what Amazon charges for these items sold separately. The dock adds 14 ports, including dual HDMI outputs, for one-cable laptop setups. It ships for free. Deal ends November 18. Buy Now at Anker Features 14 ports in one docking station 160W max total power output Data transfer speeds up to 10Gbps Dual 4K display support via two HDMI ports Three USB-C ports and one USB-A port for charging Compatible with Windows, ChromeOS, and USB-C/Thunderbolt laptops

deals.title: Open-Box Apple Pencil Pro for $85 + free shipping w/ Prime
deals.sourceText: Woot has this open-box Apple Pencil Pro at $85. It's the best deal we've seen for this model. Prime members get free shipping. Deal ends November 20. Buy Now at Woot! deals.sourceText: At Home Depot, this DeWalt Shallow Pro small parts organizer is just $15, less than half its original price of $32.98. Shipping is free, too. The removable cups can be taken out to make room for larger tools. The deal ends on December 2. deals.title: Ecoflow Rapid Pro 146W 4-Port GaN USB-C Charger w/ 3.3-Foot Cable for $38 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This Ecoflow Rapid Pro 146W charger has hit its all-time low of $38 right now at Amazon. You'd pay as much as $66 elsewhere. A single port delivers up to 140W for laptops, while four ports can run at once for 146W total. The plug folds flat and the charger weighs under 10 oz. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Amazon Features 146W total output across 4 ports Up to 140W from a single port Charges 4 devices at once (65W+45W+18W+18W) Foldable plug with included 3.3-foot 100W USB-C cable Charges a laptop from 0 to 50% in 30 minutes 24-month warranty

deals.title: eufy Security Essential Alarm System 7-Piece Home Security Kit for $250 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This 7-piece eufy Security Essential Alarm System has dropped to its best-ever price of $250 right now at Amazon. It's even cheaper than the 5-piece kit. It includes a HomeBase Mini with 64GB of local storage, a keypad, four entry sensors, and one motion sensor. Sensor batteries are rated for an average of 5 years, and more sensors or accessories can be added later. Shipping is free. Buy Now at Amazon Features 7-piece kit w/ HomeBase Mini, keypad, 4 entry sensors, and 1 motion sensor HomeBase Mini includes 64GB of local storage No monthly fee required Sensor batteries last an average of 5 years Wireless setup w/ in-app guidance and no wiring Controlled from a smartphone app w/ instant alerts 12-month manufacturer warranty

deals.title: Certified Refurb EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic 1024Wh Portable Power Station for $359 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: With promo code "SHOPBRANDS20" at eBay, this certified refurbished EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic drops to $359. That's $10 less than we saw last week and $103 cheaper than a brand-new one. The refurbished model is sold directly by EcoFlow's official store and includes a 2-year warranty and free 30-day returns. Its LiFePO4 battery holds 1,024Wh and the unit outputs 1,800W. The coupon expires on November 15. Wi-Fi & Bluetooth connectivity 2-year warranty included
